name: New York statutory deadline, retainage and tax checks
standard: New York Lien Law § 10; General Business Law §§ 756-c, 757; Tax Law § 1105(c)(3); Labor Law § 220
edition: Statutes as in force on 1 November 2026
description: Runs the checks the statutory engines compute from the New York tables: retainage above 5 percent on a private contract of 150 thousand dollars or more entered into from 17 November 2023, or on public work; a capital improvement priced tax-free with no ST-124 on file; a public work without a schedule from the state labor department or the city Comptroller; an estimate at the 4 percent state rate; and the 8 month (4 month single family) lien filing window.
